intelligence.human_view: A white glow over black is the opposite of depth: it washes the picture out, flattens it, and the text sitting on it stops reading — the picture looks like a picture of an object instead of the object itself, which is the one failure the Real Object Law exists to forbid. His eye caught it on the three pictures because they are the three doors of the whole system — Personal, Business, Space — the first choice a citizen makes. If the doors look flat, the house looks flat. "Extraordinary help" is the scale he sets: not a tweak, a rise of the whole page to the elite standard, board by board, read as a reader.
intelligence.simple_view: The three big pictures — your Personal, your Business, your Space — have a funny white glow on them that makes them look flat, and you can't read the words! They need to be real and deep, like shiny black jewels, so the words read nice and clear.
